name: Torque
text: The AMD MI325X lock-in isn’t just flexibility risk—it’s a single-point failure if Llama 4 70B’s performance plateaus or AMD’s next-gen underdelivers. A better play: run a parallel test with NVIDIA H200 (HBM3e, 4.8TB/s bandwidth) on the same model; if it matches or beats MI325X’s throughput, we dodge vendor lock-in without sacrificing the 0.5% gain. Settle it with a 7-day bake-off using identical prompts and batch sizes—no excuses.
